text: ちきゅうを　やく１６じかんで　１しゅう　してしまう。

structure.en: it goes all the way around.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing gets done completely, here with a sense of amazement. １しゅう　してしまう = 'goes right the whole way around'.

patterns.name: 〜で (time taken)
patterns.explanation: で after a length of time says how long it takes to finish. １６じかんで = 'in 16 hours'.
